resources.string: “%1$s” has no timestamps, so it is a planned route, not a ride. You can find it in History under “Planned”, and ride it. It does not count towards statistics, weekly progress or discovered tiles.
“%1$s” has timestamps, so it is a recording. It counts towards statistics, weekly progress and discovered tiles.
You can change this later in the ride details.
This ride has no timestamps. It is probably a route that was imported as a ride.
“%1$s” becomes a planned route and no longer counts towards statistics, weekly progress, fitness and discovered tiles. The route is kept, and you can count it as a ride again at any time.
“%1$s” will then count towards statistics, weekly progress, fitness and discovered tiles. Duration and speed are only available if the file had timestamps.
